summary: The recorded base reproduced missing DSV4 thinking/high defaults and a global ROCm700A workaround. The exact candidate fixes the requested source-level contract: DSV4 alone defaults to thinking/high when unset, explicit request/environment values retain precedence, other model defaults are preserved, and SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A=0 is scoped to gfx950-rocm720.

tests.command: independent DSV4 official-profile render on recorded base with SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING and SGLANG_DSV4_REASONING_EFFORT cleared
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced thinking_mode=chat, reasoning_effort=None, no <think> tag, and no high-effort instruction; the original-contract assertion failed.
Candidate regression suite: 138 passed and 70 subtests passed, covering DSV4 defaults/overrides, unchanged non-DSV4 behavior, and Docker-stage scoping.

tests.command: independent DSV4/non-DSV4 override matrix at b8b17e6d25941987360e9dad6d5d196c66b25cad
tests.what_was_measured: Official and preview unset defaults, explicit false and empty values, request precedence over environment, and non-DSV4 unset/configured behavior.

tests.command: isolated SGLANG_USE_ROCM700A={0,1} imports plus CPU-vs-ROCm numerical comparison
tests.what_was_measured: On MI355X/gfx950, flag 0 selected MAX_LEN and flag 1 selected SUM_LEN for the CUDA-graph default; GPU arithmetic matched the CPU reference with max absolute error 4.76837158203125e-07.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015; raw evidence records the flag branches and successful CPU-vs-GPU numerical check.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights were unavailable, so full-model semantics, quality, accuracy, and throughput remain unverified.
No distributed DP-attention workload was run; flag testing verifies the selected code branch, not distributed correctness or performance.
The production gfx950-rocm720 Docker image was not rebuilt; exact Dockerfile stage inheritance was validated statically and by regression.
No native/C++/FlyDSL files changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
